name: GVA TECH,Inc.
summary: GVA TECH, Inc. develops and provides legal tech platforms. Its offerings include OLGA, a legal operating system for company legal departments, an online service for preparing commercial registration change documents, corporate registration certificate services such as GVA Trademark Registration, and an AI-powered confidentiality agreement checking service. It dates from 2017 and has its head office in Shibuya, Japan.
